text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Paired change in error on the confirmation year, 2025-07 to 2026-06. The chosen-set and 2023-09 contrasts use 99.4% intervals (nine planned contrasts); the others use 95%. Dot: estimate. Line: interval from re-drawing whole months. Rule: no change.'
text.tspan: Paired change in error on the confirmation year, 2025-07 to 2026-06.
The chosen-set and 2023-09 contrasts use 99.4% intervals (nine planned contrasts); the others use 95%.
Dot: estimate. Line: interval from re-drawing whole months. Rule: no change.
